2. Summary & ranking

Of the 3 molecules screened, no single lead is robust: pyrazolopyrimidine ethyl ester and pyrazolopyrimidine propanoic acid rank within the method's resolution of one another — the top candidate changes across the 4 descriptor bases (geometry and protonation), so they are reported as a tie rather than ordered. pyrazolopyrimidine propanamide is the robustly weakest candidate, ranked last on every basis. This is a computational screening prediction requiring electrochemical confirmation (see the Method section and caveats).

6. Method & caveats

DFT level: B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) (ddCOSMO:water). Global descriptors come from the frontier-orbital energies via Koopmans' theorem; ΔN uses the metal work function with η(metal) = 0. The Monte-Carlo and Brownian-MD stages use a classical van-der-Waals adsorption model — a physics-based screening surrogate, not a substitute for periodic DFT or for electrochemical validation. The composite ranking is a heuristic that orders candidates; it does not prove inhibition. Full methodology: docs/pipeline.md; validation record: docs/validation.md.
